title: Full Adder From NAND Gates Only
constraints: A full adder: `{cout, sum} = a + b + cin`.
Use **only** Verilog `nand` gate primitives (2 or 3 inputs). No `assign`, `always`, operators or other gates. The classic solution uses 9 two-input NANDs.
hints: XOR from 4 NANDs: `t = NAND(a, b)`, `x = NAND(NAND(a, t), NAND(b, t))`.
Chain two XORs for the sum. The carry reuses the first NAND of each XOR: `cout = NAND(t1, t2)`.

forbidden.message: only `nand` gate instances are allowed (no assign, always, operators or other gates)
